title: Retro Chests
intro: Retro Chests are diamond chests costing 39 diamonds each. They contain puzzle pieces from Friendship, Normal, and Epic Chests (excluding those chests' exclusive animals) and have their own large pool of exclusive animals.
obtaining_body: Retro Chests can be obtained from several sources: quests, leveling up, monthly login rewards, the Zoo Academy, and the Events Shop.
contents_body: Retro Chests contain puzzle pieces from Friendship, Normal, and Epic Chests, but do not include the exclusive animals from those chests. Every Retro Chest guarantees at least one exclusive puzzle piece.
drop_bonus_body: Retro Chests feature a rotating drop bonus that boosts the chance of receiving a specific exclusive animal's puzzle pieces. The boosted animal changes every 4 weeks, rotating through the exclusive animal list. This system has been active since November 24, 2022.
animals_body: The following animals are exclusive to Retro Chests and cannot be obtained through any other chest type:
tips_body: Retro Chests rotate their drop bonus every 4 weeks — check the current boosted animal before opening chests if you are targeting a specific exclusive. At 39 diamonds, Retro Chests are more affordable than Legendary Chests and offer a wide selection of exclusive animals, making them a good option for players focused on completing their collections.
